Subject: Overpayments across June/July invoices — request for consolidated credit and VAT treatment

Hi Markus,

Hope you’re well — I’m Sophie from CrossBay Finance. We ran our monthly reconciliation and found duplicate meter processing that caused CrossBay to be overbilled across three invoices (details below). We’d like to request a consolidated credit and clarification on VAT handling so we can close the quarter cleanly on our side.

Affected invoices:
- INV-2026-06-0012 (EUR)
- INV-2026-07-0018 (EUR)
- INV-2026-07-0023 (EUR)

Total overcharged (gross): EUR 14,320. VAT was charged at varying rates because two of the invoices were billed to CrossBay Analytics Ltd (GB) and one to CrossBay GmbH (DE). We’ve attached our VAT certificates and a quick ledger extract for those invoices (crossbay_vat_evidence.zip).

Ask:
1) Can Redwood issue a single consolidated credit memo that shows the gross amounts and the VAT breakdown by invoice/entity?
2) If possible, please route the VAT-credit lines so our accounting teams can post them under the proper local VAT reports. If Redwood needs to issue separate credit notes per legal entity to satisfy local bookkeeping, please confirm.
3) We prefer an offset against the next invoice, but if Redwood requires a bank refund we can provide IBAN for CrossBay GmbH.

Appreciate a short plan and ETA so we can record this in our Q3 closing.

Thanks,
Sophie Turner
Head of Finance — CrossBay Analytics
Sophie Turner | CrossBay Analytics

Attachments: crossbay_vat_evidence.zip (VAT certs, ledger.csv)

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. I’m looping in Laura from Accounting to confirm VAT routing.

Short plan:
- I’ll validate the line-level usage with our billing pipeline and confirm the gross overcharge by EOB Monday (our side).
- If the numbers match, we will prepare a consolidated credit memo that includes a VAT breakdown per invoice and per legal entity. If local bookkeeping requires separate credit notes per legal entity, Laura will advise and we will issue separate credit memos but deliver an aggregated PDF for your reconciliation.
- By default we can apply the credit to your next invoice; if you prefer a wire refund, please confirm which legal entity/IBAN to use.

Can you confirm whether CrossBay prefers offset -> next invoice, or an immediate refund to DE IBAN? If refund, please attach the beneficiary IBAN and account name.

Best,
Markus Klein

Please confirm choice A or B. If B, reply with the DE IBAN and we’ll route the payment. If A, no further action required — you’ll see the credit applied on your next billing cycle and we’ll share the internal credit note refs once posted.
